summary: All four round-2 must-fix items are resolved in both locales: ex-split leaves saving to the backend's API, q9's en key says "yet" again, q3's options all end in 「よ」 and the checklist labels are in です・ます. The 13 changed blocks add no error of classes (a)–(e) and the en no longer says "rebuild" beside the defined Build, so a11y_l10n rises to 4; voice stays at 3 for a few stiff spots (s2-b5, s4-tools, q9's 「依頼として頼みます」, q2 d's 「省いて」), all niceToHave.
